notes: The set holds two independent models built from separate bags: the yellow Racer X car (steps 1-36) and the red Taejo car (steps 37-70). The booklet really builds them separately, so the graph has two separate groups of pieces, not one. The only link between them is the single shared sticker sheet p221, which carries the decals for both cars.

The two cars sit in one coordinate frame, so the red car is offset by +30 in x to stop the models overlapping. Each car's own coordinates are otherwise independent, with the nose at its low x and y running across the width.

Within each car the sub-assemblies are joined by pieces that bridge them. Yellow: p136 bridges nose and middle, and p31 bridges middle and rear. Red: p57 bridges nose and cockpit, and p142 bridges cockpit and rear. These bridging placements are my best estimate of how the booklet's 'join the sub-assemblies' steps work.

Nothing rests on a smooth tile or on a piece with no top studs: tiles, wheel arches, curved 3x1 bricks, seats, steering stands, the inverted slopes and the windscreens. Pieces that sat on those were moved onto studded parts.

The big curved hood p167 (4 x 6) is laid turned so that its 6-stud length runs across the car and clears the cockpit parts. On the yellow car the mid-body plate stack p38/p140/p189/p190/p223/p225 is shifted one stud so it clears the 4x4 plate p205.

The piece list is pooled by colour, so I assigned pieces to each car by matching the pictures. Several assignments and all positions are my best estimates, because the isometric pictures are ambiguous. The least certain are the gray slopes and bricks, the black plates and brackets, and the small red plates and tiles.

Step numbers count sub-assemblies, and the main steps that only join sub-assemblies carry no pieces, so some step numbers have no pieces. Some later-built pieces were repositioned, so a few step numbers differ slightly from the booklet's order.
Minifigures (helmets, heads, torsos, legs) are not in the piece list and are not modelled.

The sticker sheet (p221), axles, bushes, wheels, tyres, wheel covers, the two windscreens and the sideways plate p135 are off the stud grid (position null) and are recorded in other_joins. The windscreens clip onto studs, so their join targets are approximate.
The hinge pairs (white bases p146/p147 with black tops p148/p149) are linked as hinge joins. The tops are also given grid positions above their bases, as an approximation.
The curved 4x1 slopes (p197-p204) are stacked on the front bumper pieces, because they could not rest on the stud-less wheel arches. This is a simplification of the booklet's front-end trim.
